title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling samples, and quickstart docs
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds a set of RAG agent templates, TypeScript and Python tool-calling examples, and a docs site quickstart for RAG agents. Motivation: provide a consistent, production-oriented set of examples to accelerate customer adoption and reduce support load for common RAG+agent patterns. Changes include: 1) canonical agent templates (retriever + tool-caller + safe-fallback) under redwood-examples/agents; 2) end-to-end TypeScript and Python samples that demonstrate tool registration, structured outputs, and streaming responses; 3) new docs quickstart and troubleshooting guide in redwood-docs that surface recommended batching/quantization settings for hosted vs dedicated; 4) copy for the docs site and code snippets for the snippets library. Checklist: - [x] Agent templates implemented - [x] TypeScript and Python examples added - [x] Docs quickstart and troubleshooting written - [x] CI/docs site builds pass - [x] Reviewed and approved by runtime and docs. Related: Linear ENG-5421 (RAG agent quickstarts), PM-812 (docs landing). This PR aims for minimal breaking changes — mostly examples and docs — but it also adds a small helper in redwood-examples shared_utils to standardize tool registration across languages.
